title: Gibbs-state-weighted common-core eventual generator intertwining

exact_scope.carrier_family: The unchanged PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2: V_n={(i,j):0<=i<=n+1,j in {0,1}}, h_i^j for 0<=i<=n, v_i for 0<=i<=n+1, d_i for 0<=i<n, split triangles for i<n and the unsplit frontier square q_n.
exact_scope.anchors: O={(0,0)} and C={(0,1)}; the declared anchor-preserving automorphism is the identity.
exact_scope.regulator: Use the unchanged PAH-001 finite regulator and, for the R-488/R-490 path, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, Q=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=0 and all displayed couplings one; n>=2 and R_max=R>=1 are the only OMC-010 uniform labels.
exact_scope.functional: Use exactly PAH-001 F_rho, including onsite, aperture stiffness, covariant matter edge and plaquette Wilson terms, with no added term or changed coefficient.
exact_scope.generator_domain: D_(n,Q) is the finite-dimensional space of all bounded functions on the full displayed fixed-Q state space Omega_(n,Q), with L_n given by the unchanged PAH-001 directed-root midpoint rates.
exact_scope.common_cylinder_algebra: A_cyl^R488 is the algebraic union of bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant functions of finitely many integer coordinates ell_v and finitely many closed-face holonomy characters. The R-488 four-coordinate generators (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) are included.
exact_scope.neutral_refinement: I_(n,n+1) is the pointwise lift f composed with p_(n+1,n), where p retains every old geometric coordinate and drops the new column n+2 and newly split diagonal d_n; the dropped aperture, radial, phase and link coordinates are assigned neutral values only for the forward inclusion.
exact_scope.root_correspondence: On the image of the neutral inclusion, each retained old PAH root keeps its exact geometric label, admissibility, delta-F, endpoint mobility, midpoint rate and cylinder increment. Roots whose support is outside the interaction closure of f have zero f-increment. No source/rate is altered.
exact_scope.gibbs_norm: Use the unchanged PAH-OMC-010 normalized Gibbs weight and C_sw=540 only as a state-weighted domination input; C_sw is not an intertwining proof.
exact_scope.limit: No infinite-volume, continuum, physical-sector or observation limit is taken in this packet. n is a finite refinement label and R is held fixed for the domain audit.

pre_registered_stabilization.interaction_closure: For f, cl(f) is the union of the geometric supports of every PAH-001 energy term that can change f under a directed root; let m_f=max{i:(i,j) in cl(f)} and m_f=-1 for the constant function.
pre_registered_stabilization.N_of_f: N(f)=max(2,m_f+1). For every n>=N(f), q_n, the new column n+2 and d_n are disjoint from cl(f), so the R-484 split boundary is separated from the support on the image-restricted domain.
pre_registered_stabilization.boundary_defect: The R-484 square-to-split boundary has exact hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 and is retained. It is outside cl(f) once n>=N(f); this is a locality statement, not deletion of the defect.
pre_registered_stabilization.conditional_locality_statement: If p_(n+1,n) is total on the chosen state domain, the rootwise local tuples agree for n>=N(f) and the pointwise generator defect is zero. The full Omega_(n+1,Q) domain is not yet shown to satisfy that premise for Q>0.

domain_obstruction.witness: For any n>=2, take a valid fine state in Omega_(n+1,Q=1) with ell_(n+2,0)=1 and every old ell_v=0; assign any admitted apertures, phases and links.
domain_obstruction.projection_image: The declared neutral projection drops the new column, so the retained charge sum is 0, not Q=1.
domain_obstruction.consequence: p_(n+1,n) is not a map Omega_(n+1,1)->Omega_(n,1). Therefore I_(n,n+1) and I_(n,n+1)L_n are not defined on the full fine Gibbs domain, and an all-state exact intertwining theorem cannot be claimed without a source-authorized domain repair.
domain_obstruction.weak_l2_scope: The witness has strictly positive finite PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weight, so the full-domain lifted observable and its weighted L2 defect are undefined rather than proved zero. This packet does not assert that every image-restricted weak L2 limit fails.

acceptance.primary: Hash-pin all parent bytes, verify the strip/root formulas, prove the explicit N(f) locality rule and exact Q=1 projection obstruction.
acceptance.independent: Rebuild the charge and support arguments directly without importing the primary implementation.
acceptance.hostile: Reject any attempted Q=0 substitution, image-only result reported as all-state, conditional averaging, rate fitting, C_sw-as-proof, off-by-one N(f), or physical promotion.
acceptance.lean: Formalize the exact charge-loss witness, N(f) separation arithmetic, retained R-484 defect, C_sw role and non-promotion firewall.
acceptance.release: All generated ledgers and release checks must pass; no gate or claim tier changes.

known_boundaries: R-484 proves only the Q=0 anchor-aperture patch, and R-488 proves only the Q=1 G_2->G_3 four-coordinate patch fixture; neither is an all-cylinder theorem.
The neutral inclusion is total on the Q=0 slice and on the R-488 patch image, but totality on the full Q=1 state spaces is missing.
C_sw=540 is a domination constant from R-490 and cannot define a common core or establish exact intertwining.
No weak Gibbs-L2 convergence statement is available until the lift is a function on the full weighted domain.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
falsifiers: Any parent hash differs or any parent functional/rate is changed.
The charge-loss witness is not a valid state of the displayed PAH-001 Q=1 domain.
A source-authorized full-Q domain map is supplied and independently proves projection totality and rootwise equality for every finite-support cylinder.
The exact R-484 defect is erased, averaged away or numerically replaced.
C_sw is used as a substitute for a rootwise intertwining proof or a Q=0 calculation is promoted to Q=1 all-state evidence.
non_claims: This is a T0 claim-nonbearing domain/locality audit, not a new PAH model.
The image-restricted N(f)=max(2,m_f+1) locality statement does not close the full fixed-Q common-core theorem.
The full-domain exact intertwining is not refuted by a numerical rate counterexample; it is held because the declared lift is not total for Q>0.
Weak Gibbs-L2 convergence is likewise undefined on the full domain and is not classified as a universal no-go.
Markov time is external stochastic time only.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
single_next_question: Can a source-authorized fixed-Q common domain (or an explicitly admitted full-Q refinement map) make p_(n+1,n) total while preserving the unchanged PAH-001 root rates for every finite-support cylinder, without conditional averaging or changing the model?
revisit_condition: Reopen only after that one domain/map contract is hash-pinned and an independent rootwise proof covers all full-Q states; then test weighted L2 convergence separately.
